Before You Clear, Move, or Rename Anything

Important: Your working records are stored in browser storage. Export a Full Backup before clearing browser/site data, changing browser profiles, moving to another computer, or renaming/moving the dashboard file. Some browsers can treat a moved local HTML file as a different storage context.

Data Safety Reminder
